answer: For a poll on storing a nectar sculpture beside a seed kernel in a vault, the server checks election-bound signatures against a frozen roll of 100 keys. It rejects invalid or repeat ballots; passage requires yes ballots from at least 51 listed keys, regardless of turnout. Without other support, an attacker needs 51 keys. A sybil-filled roll can undermine the rule, and abstentions make passage harder.
